scope.flow: increaseLiquidityCurrentRange interacting with Uniswap Nonfungible Position Manager using block.timestamp as deadline

statements.text: increaseLiquidityCurrentRange passes block.timestamp as the deadline argument to the Uniswap Nonfungible Position Manager, so the deadline check compares block.timestamp against the same value and is a no-op.
A submitted transaction with insufficient gas may not be mined immediately and remains pending.
Pending transactions can be executed maliciously at a later time by malicious actors or MEV bots at a disadvantage to the original submitter.
The deadline passed to the Uniswap Nonfungible Position Manager should bound execution time so a pending transaction cannot be executed at an arbitrarily later time.

ambiguities: No explicit action step is described; the report only states that delayed pending transactions can be executed later by malicious actors or MEV bots.
The report does not state who submits the transaction or whether the caller is unauthorized.
No concrete numeric deadline or bound is given.
